annotations.title: TIA — create HMI Unified tag table

description: Creates a tag table in a WinCC Unified HMI. Refused, nothing changed: 400 invalid_name (details.kind, name, rule) for a blank, over-long or malformed name, 409 name_collision (details.existing) for a used name. The result is {hmi, tagTable, created:true, postcheck}. dryRun (Gd11) is answered by the serve: it runs every guard the real write runs and answers {dryRun:true, status:"plan_ok", hmi, ...} with no `postcheck`, changing nothing. A real write answers the re-read values and a `postcheck` {verified:true, requested, actual}; a mismatch is 409 postcheck_failed (details.mismatches, details.rollback: restored, not_restored or not_attempted): re-read before anything else. Needs an open project and a WinCC Unified HMI (hmi = its name from tia_hmis, matched ignoring case): a classic WinCC HMI is refused with 409 hmi_not_unified, an unknown HMI is 404 not_found and two HMIs with the same name are 409 ambiguous_name. Maps to POST /hmi/{hmi}/tagtables {name}. M-off.

dryRun.description: Gd11: plan-without-applying — validates the guards and describes the action WITHOUT mutating the project

hmi.description: HMI name, as listed by tia_hmis (a WinCC Unified HMI)

name.description: tag table name: letters, digits, underscores, spaces and hyphens, at most 128 characters, no trailing space; unique among all tag tables, ignoring case
